angularDiameterSource: No angular diameter is measured: this is the model radius, 1.7 solar radii (Donati et al. 2012), at the Gaia distance.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 source 6011522757643074304: parallax 6.4893 mas, inverted to 154.0997 pc with no zero-point correction.
radiusSource: Radius 1.7 +/- 0.2 solar radii, temperature 4300 +/- 50 K and mass 1.05 +/- 0.07 solar masses from Donati et al. (2012, MNRAS; doi:10.1111/j.1365-2966.2012.21482.x; arXiv:1206.1770), from spectropolarimetry of the star and evolutionary models, as the ESO SupJup survey tabulates them (Gonzalez Picos et al. 2025, A&A; doi:10.1051/0004-6361/202451936; arXiv:2501.01789, Table 1). A model radius: the disc is not measured. 1,182,690 km at 695,700 km per solar radius; GM from 1.05 solar masses times the JPL solar GM. presentationUp: the display axis (celestial north at the star) is up; no spin axis is measured on the sky.
effectiveTemperatureSource: 4300 +/- 50 K: Donati et al. (2012, MNRAS), as tabulated by Gonzalez Picos et al. (2025), Table 1, https://arxiv.org/abs/1206.1770
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/gq-lup.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 3.998, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of GQ Lup (pscomppars): spectral type K7e V, from Neuhauser et al. 2005 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2005A&A...435L..13N/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, V* GQ Lup: main object type Or*, Orion Variable
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of GQ Lup (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.35 dex, from Swastik et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..114S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of GQ Lup (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.07239, from Gaia DR2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...616A...1G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of GQ Lup (pscomppars): age 0.001 Gyr, from Neuhauser et al. 2005 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2005A&A...435L..13N/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: VizieR J/AJ/165/164/table2 (Tull RVels, rotation periods and Inclinations), column Prot: 8.4 d, the row 0.0 arcsec from the star's J2000 place. The middle of 2 catalogued periods, 2 of them within 20% of it

projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of GQ Lup (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 6.33 km/s, from Swastik et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..114S/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published model radius. The star's disc is not resolved; its color is a blackbody at the published temperature.
